info.title: Monetizze Universal API
info.description: Manage Monetizze transactions, subscriptions, checkouts, and billing updates

get.description: Finds transactions in Monetizze by product, email, date, or status.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: product
parameters.description: Filter by product code.

parameters.name: transaction
parameters.description: Filter by sale code.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Filter by buyer email.

parameters.name: dateMin
parameters.description: Minimum transaction creation date and time in yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss format.

schema.description: Minimum transaction creation date and time in yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss format.

parameters.name: dateMax
parameters.description: Maximum transaction creation date and time in yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss format.

schema.description: Maximum transaction creation date and time in yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss format.

parameters.name: endDateMin
parameters.description: Minimum finalized sale date and time in yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss format.

schema.description: Minimum finalized sale date and time in yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss format.

parameters.name: endDateMax
parameters.description: Maximum finalized sale date and time in yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss format.

schema.description: Maximum finalized sale date and time in yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss format.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Optional sale status filter values such as 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, or 6.

schema.description: Optional sale status filter values such as 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, or 6.

parameters.name: paymentMethod
parameters.description: Optional payment method filter values such as 1, 3, 4, or 8.

schema.description: Optional payment method filter values such as 1, 3, 4, or 8.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number starting at 1.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

dados.description: Transaction rows array; currently empty in runtime evidence.

recordCount.description: Total records count returned by Monetizze.

status.description: HTTP-style status value returned by Monetizze.
